plan.title: CommonPlace Console 1.0
plan.objective: Ship one read-only RustyRed console core into a pinned gpui-component native operator console and a consent-installed CommonPlace web block, with identical seeded data, transparent authenticated doors, deterministic graph layout, live watch inspection, and explicit visual and cross-realm proof.

acceptance_criteria.text: B1, B2, B3, F1, F2, F3, named choices, reporting, and every out-of-scope boundary in SPEC-COMMONPLACE-CONSOLE-1.0 are represented by grounded plan tasks.
Both native and wasm32 console-core targets build from the same serde types and fixture results.
The native console uses gpui-component v0.5.1 pinned at 0f0ab35233212f8f3277028995caf0c41e13ee6c and GPUI v0.2.2 pinned at 69e2130295c2649963eb639fc70b4f2ee8ea1624.
The web console installs through explicit corpus-read consent, remains read-only, and exposes the same five v1 surfaces.
A seeded cross-realm honesty test proves equal counts and entity identities.
Runtime complete, Product complete, and Vision complete are reported independently with baseline, target, after, and Do Not Downgrade evidence.

tasks.title: Prove cross-realm honesty and visual acceptance
tasks.goal: Run deterministic cross-realm fixtures, behavioral tests, web visual baselines, native visual evidence, and repository gates; document runtime, product, and vision as separate truth layers.
acceptance_criteria: Existing console fence, token, contrast, motion, icon, type, unit, and Playwright gates remain green.
Final documentation separates implemented runtime facts, shipped product integration, and future vision, including branch-local backend dependencies.
Native and web realms consume the same serialized dataset and produce matching formatted values, diffs, watch ordering, and graph position hashes.
Native screenshots are captured and compared against the declared target, or the exact inability to capture is reported.
Updated web screenshots are reviewed at desktop and compact viewports.
tasks.proof_command: npm --prefix apps/console run test:e2e -- --grep "Your data|Data console"
tasks.provenance: SPEC-COMMONPLACE-CONSOLE-1.0 acceptance criteria; UI visual project gates; CommonPlace console merge gates

tasks.title: Build the consent-installed web console block
tasks.goal: Create the CommonPlace console plugin package and web block renderer using the same Rust core through WASM, register it in the descriptor registry, and implement transparent plugin and standing-query door adapters without importing apps/web.
acceptance_criteria: No RustyRed, GPUI, or native transport type crosses into the React renderer.
The graph surface uses cosmos.gl with static shared positions and lifecycle-safe cleanup.
The package exposes install, consent, deny, uninstall, capability, and slot metadata matching the audited plugin GraphQL contract.
The web console is a registered block/view descriptor and not a bespoke route-only island.
The web realm loads shared fixture/core behavior through WASM and renders the five read-only surfaces.
tasks.proof_command: npm --prefix apps/console exec vitest run src/lib/console-plugin/console-plugin.test.ts src/views/ConsoleDataView.test.tsx
tasks.provenance: SPEC-COMMONPLACE-CONSOLE-1.0 F2; SPEC-COMMONPLACE-PLUGINS-1.0; audited plugin branch commit 440987aeaa5c60bab02d169ea71a7a3e0a3b9e3a; cosmos.gl v3 documentation

tasks.title: Build the native GPUI operator console
tasks.goal: Create the pinned native GPUI application and render the five read-only operator surfaces using gpui-component for shell, dock, tables, charts, controls, dialogs, tabs, and lists, with a custom graph element only where the library has no equivalent.
acceptance_criteria: Golden records, graph, merge receipts, standing queries, and watch inspector surfaces are usable with shared fixture data.
Native tests and a launch smoke check pass, or any platform/build limitation is recorded with exact evidence.
Theorem-owned Shell, DockHost, and SurfaceHost public traits do not expose GPUI types.
apps/console-native is a standalone locked Cargo workspace pinned to gpui-component 0f0ab35233212f8f3277028995caf0c41e13ee6c and GPUI 69e2130295c2649963eb639fc70b4f2ee8ea1624.
gpui-component supplies the standard shell and controls; only graph painting is custom.
tasks.provenance: SPEC-COMMONPLACE-CONSOLE-1.0 F1; SPEC-COMMONPLACE-NATIVE-SHELL-1.0; official gpui-component v0.5.1 docs and examples

tasks.title: Establish console core contracts and dependency baselines
tasks.goal: Create the dual-target Rust console core, shared seeded dataset, realm-neutral Door contract, GraphQL request documents, deterministic formatter and diff model, exact dependency evidence, and visual baseline manifest.
acceptance_criteria: Dependency baselines name the exact gpui-component, GPUI, plugin-contract, and standing-query commits and distinguish branch-local contracts from mainline availability.
Fixture data and formatting are deterministic and reusable by both realms.
The core expresses GoldenId, records, merges, standing-query definitions and firings, plugin metadata, query results, and door capability/receipt metadata.
The shared console core builds for host and wasm32 without RustyRed, GPUI, React, browser, or transport types in its public domain API.
The visual baseline manifest records existing web snapshots and explicitly records the native baseline as unavailable.
tasks.provenance: SPEC-COMMONPLACE-CONSOLE-1.0 sections 0-4, B1, Named choices; companion native-shell, plugins, and standing-query specs; exact upstream refs recorded during dependency audit

tasks.title: Implement deterministic graph simulation
tasks.goal: Implement the shared seeded velocity-Verlet and Barnes-Hut force simulation with stable graph topology, deterministic positions, bounded numerical behavior, and realm-neutral frame output.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned or selected nodes remain stable, invalid values are rejected, and repeated runs produce byte-equivalent serialized frames.
Repulsion uses a Barnes-Hut quadtree and integration uses velocity-Verlet semantics.
Tests cover empty, singleton, disconnected, pinned, and non-finite inputs.
The simulator accepts the shared graph model and emits deterministic frames for a fixed seed.

tasks.title: Implement bounded live-watch inspection
tasks.goal: Implement the shared watch-inspector model with ordered delivery, bounded ring storage, rate accounting, pause/resume, filter semantics, and drop-safe subscription ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Dropping a subscription handle unregisters it from the realm door.
Pause, resume, filtering, empty streams, bursts, and unsubscribe are covered by deterministic tests.
The inspector ring is bounded and reports dropped-event counts and event rate.
Watch events preserve source order and expose monotonic sequence metadata.
tasks.provenance: SPEC-COMMONPLACE-CONSOLE-1.0 B3 and Standing Queries watch behavior

tasks.title: Add consent-aware Your data entry points
tasks.goal: Add Your data entry points in Index and Appearance so first use explains read-only permissions and requests consent while installed users open the console directly.
acceptance_criteria: Consent persists through the plugin contract and installed users open directly.
Denial leaves the console uninstalled and does not expose data.
First use shows purpose, read-only capability scope, data doors, allow, and deny actions before opening.
Index and Appearance expose a discoverable Your data action.
Keyboard and pointer paths are covered by browser tests.
